<!-- Read CONTRIBUTING.md before submitting. Use an English title such as
     fix: describe the change. Keep this PR focused on one change.
     Do not disclose vulnerabilities or include credentials or personal traffic. -->

## Problem

<!-- What problem does this solve? Link an issue if one exists.
     Use Fixes #123 only if this PR fully resolves that issue. -->

## Solution

<!-- What changed and why? Mention alternatives or trade-offs where relevant. -->

## Verification

<!-- List the exact commands you ran and their results, plus manual app checks.
     For a bug fix, describe the regression test or reproducible manual test.
     State which checks you did not run and why. Do not claim unexecuted checks passed. -->

## UI evidence

<!-- For UI changes, attach sanitized before/after screenshots or a recording
     from the actual app. Otherwise write "Not applicable".
     If native capture is unavailable, explain the limitation. -->

## Risks and behavior changes

<!-- Note changed defaults, connection interruptions, permissions, data/schema
     changes, breaking changes, or migration/recovery steps. Otherwise write "None".
     Link dependent PRs in other repositories and state the merge order. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR is focused; substantial changes were discussed with a maintainer first.
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand the entire change, including any AI-generated content.
- [ ] I have documented actual verification results and any checks not run.
- [ ] I have updated relevant tests/documentation or explained why no update is needed.
- [ ] No credentials, subscription URLs, signing keys, personal data, or generated release artifacts are included.
